name: Aegean family compatibility suite

checks.rule: unknown values are not imputed for cross-corpus comparison
cross-corpus metrics require compatible definitions and provenance
cross-script relationships do not redefine native identifiers
blocked native gates cannot be opened by family release/version changes
baseline and representative-pilot artifacts are present
member version need not equal other family member versions
Phaistos Disc faces remain one object; membership implies neither linguistic affinity nor pooled evidence.

claim_boundary: Suite checks architecture and governance compatibility; it does not certify epigraphic correctness.
